name: Ramwrought Siegework
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

Traits.name: Siege Advance
Traits.text: While the siegework is moving toward a creature it has damaged within the last 24 hours, the siegework's Speed can't be reduced and Difficult Terrain doesn't cost it extra movement.

Traits.name: Magic Resistance
Traits.text: The siegework has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The siegework makes two Splintering Fist attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Ramming Shoulder.

Actions.name: Splintering Fist
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 27 (5d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.name: Ramming Shoulder
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target is pushed up to 15 feet away from the siegework and has the Prone condition.
Actions.gmQuote: a siege engine golem of lashed timber that shoulders through walls

lore: Built by a siege master to walk through the walls other armies stop at, it still hunts the next standing wall.

generation.userConcept: a siege-engine golem of lashed timber that shoulders through walls

clauses.text: a siege-engine golem of lashed timber

generation.cite: composition after Flesh Golem (CR 5) — the made thing that cannot be unmade

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
